jurisdiction: municipal (rates set by OUC board; not PSC rate-regulated)
notes: DemandLevel charge depends on the month's maximum 15-minute kW: Tier 1 (<8 kW) $5, Tier 2 (8-12 kW) $10, Tier 3 (>=12 kW) $15. Bills depend on peak kW, not only kWh; the comparison assumes Tier 1 unless peak_kw is given.
Minimum bill is customer charge plus DemandLevel charge.
City of Orlando utility tax excluded.
